description_en: Adds tags to specified cloud desktops. This makes it easier to filter and manage cloud desktops by tag
description_zh: 为指定的云电脑添加标签，方便通过标签统一筛选和管理云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun ecd tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::GWS::INSTANCE --resource-id ecd-ia2zw38bi6cm70000 --tag Value=design Key=department --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the list of regions supported by Wuying Cloud Desktop
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs, that is, the list of cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表，即云电脑ID列表。可包含1\~50个
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify 1 to 20 tags
parameters.name: tag
